EPS for iRhythm Technologies, Inc. (IRTC) Expected At $-0.46 Posted by Gary Bell 26 pm
Analysts expect iRhythm Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:IRTC) to report $-0.46 EPS on February, 13.They anticipate $0.02 EPS change or 4.17 % from last quarter’s $-0.48 EPS. After having $-0.43 EPS previously, iRhythm Technologies, Inc.’s analysts see 6.98 % EPS growth. The stock increased 2.04% or $1.69 during the last trading session, reaching $84.64. About 193,332 shares traded. iRhythm Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:IRTC) has risen 37.91% since January 28, 2018 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 37.91% the S&P500.
iRhythm Technologies, Inc., a digital healthcare company, focuses on the provision of ambulatory electrocardiogram, or ECG, monitoring for patients at risk for arrhythmias in the United States. The company has market cap of $2.05 billion. It offers ZIO Service, a platform that provides wearable biosensor with cloud data analytics that distill data from heartbeats into clinically actionable information. It currently has negative earnings.
